text:
marie: quick async standup — roadmap + launch prep.
What I did: locked down canary metrics, merged the spec updates to /docs/feature-routing, and ran the dry-run on staging.
Blockers: waiting on infra quota bump and one reviewer on PR #742.
Today: finalize rollout checklist, pair with tejas on canary thresholds, and publish the launch playbook by EOD. :memo:

ben: ran smoke tests for model-variant routing, all green locally. No blockers. Planning to land PR #745 this afternoon and update the console filter for cost-by-route. @marie can you confirm wording for the chart?

tejas: talked to cloud team — quota increase approved but needs org-level request (they gave a ticket template). Also found a scaling regression when pool size > 32 pods; repro steps below:
```
# repro
ab -n 1000 -c 50 http://staging/redwood/api/generate
watch -n 0.5 'kubectl top pods --namespace inference'
```
I'll add a short test to catch this in CI. Blocking on time to write the test.

lia: filed INC-8821 with cloud support (link in ticket registry). ETA ~48h. Left comments on PR #742 about the latency fallback wording. Small suggestion: change rollout step 3 from `full` to `dry-run`.

sam: ping on reviews — I'll take PR #742 and #745 today, aiming to ship by 5pm PT. Quick note: when we roll, use the canary script that zeros traffic then ramps to 5% then 25% — snippet below:
```
# canary ramp example
set_traffic --route inference --pct 5 --wait 10m
set_traffic --route inference --pct 25 --wait 20m
monitor-health --threshold 0.995
```
@deploy-bot can you post current canary status?

deploy-bot: Canary for release/2026-03-16: 3/4 healthchecks passing, fallback route briefly engaged in us-west-2 at 15:42 UTC, auto-retry scheduled for 15:55 UTC. No action required yet.

marie: thanks — action items summary:
- @sam: review + approve #742 and #745 (EOD)
- @ben: land #745 and update console chart text after confirmation
- @lia: monitor INC-8821 and update thread when support replies
- @tejas: add CI regression test for pool scaling and pair with me on thresholds
I'll update the roadmap board and send the RFC digest by 18:00 PT. :rocket:
